title: Heart Sutra 1 San Miguel de Allende
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up the Heart Sutra at a retreat in San Miguel de Allende, starting with the text's path from India to China to Mexico. Nomon tells of the monk Xuanzang, who chants the sutra while lost in a desert and carries a pack of sutras home after sixteen years. Then Nomon reads the prologue from the longer version, where Shariputra asks Avalokiteshvara how to practice, and considers how asking a question opens space for both people. The session ends with a paired exercise: one person asks "What do you want to offer the world?" again and again, and the other answers from the heart.
